shadowSentences: I love reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
I enjoy cooking new recipes on weekends.
Traveling to new places helps me learn a lot.
Listening to music makes me feel relaxed and happy.
I often go for walks in the park near my house.
Spending time with friends is very important to me.
Hiking in the mountains is one of my favorite activities.
I try to learn something new every month to grow.
Volunteering in my community gives me a sense of purpose.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable trip you have taken?
Q2: What were some challenges you faced while traveling?
Q3: How do you feel travel impacts personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about study methods.
questions: Q1: What study techniques have worked best for you?
Q2: Have you encountered any difficulties while studying?
Q3: In your opinion, what makes a study method effective?
Q4: What recommendations would you offer to improve study habits?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about the impact of technology.
questions: Q1: How has technology changed the way you communicate?
Q2: What challenges do you face with technology in daily life?
Q3: What is your opinion on the role of technology in education?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone struggling with tech usage?
